mapper.select: SELECT MAX(VERSION_NO) FROM PT_TAG_RULE_SET WHERE TAG_ID = #{tagId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_TAG_RULE_SET (ID, TAG_ID, VERSION_NO, MATCH_MODE, STATUS, PUBLISHED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{tagId}, #{version}, #{matchMode}, #{status}, #{publishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO PT_TAG_RULE_CONDITION (ID, RULE_SET_ID, INDICATOR_ID, OPERATOR_CODE, EXPECTED_VALUES, SORT_NO, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{ruleSetId}, #{indicatorId}, #{operator}, #{expectedValues}, #{sortNo}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TAG_ID, VERSION_NO AS VERSION, MATCH_MODE, STATUS, PUBLISHED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_TAG_RULE_SET WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT ID, TAG_ID, VERSION_NO AS VERSION, MATCH_MODE, STATUS, PUBLISHED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_TAG_RULE_SET ORDER BY UPDATED_AT DESC, ID
SELECT ID, TAG_ID, VERSION_NO AS VERSION, MATCH_MODE, STATUS, PUBLISHED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM PT_TAG_RULE_SET WHERE STATUS = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY TAG_ID
SELECT ID, RULE_SET_ID, INDICATOR_ID, OPERATOR_CODE AS OPERATOR, EXPECTED_VALUES, SORT_NO, CREATED_AT FROM PT_TAG_RULE_CONDITION WHERE RULE_SET_ID = #{ruleSetId} ORDER BY SORT_NO, ID
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_TAG_RULE_SET SET STATUS = 'DISABLED', UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND STATUS = 'PUBLISHED'
UPDATE PT_TAG_RULE_SET SET STATUS = 'PUBLISHED', PUBLISHED_AT = #{publishedAt}, UPDATED_AT = #{publishedAt} WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_RULE_EVAL_BATCH (ID, BATCH_NO, RULE_SET_ID, STATUS, SCANNED_COUNT, MATCHED_COUNT, EXPIRED_COUNT, ERROR_MESSAGE, STARTED_AT, FINISHED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{batchNo}, #{ruleSetId}, #{status}, #{scannedCount}, #{matchedCount}, #{expiredCount}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_RULE_EVAL_BATCH SET STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, FINISHED_AT = #{finishedAt} WHERE BATCH_NO = #{batchNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PT_PERSON_TAG_EVIDENCE (ID, PERSON_ID, TAG_ID, SOURCE_TYPE, RULE_SET_ID, RULE_VERSION, BATCH_NO, MATCH_DETAIL, EVIDENCE_STATUS, REVIEW_STATUS, REVIEWED_BY, REVIEWED_AT, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{id}, #{personId}, #{tagId}, #{sourceType}, #{ruleSetId}, #{ruleVersion}, #{batchNo}, #{matchDetail}, #{evidenceStatus}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PT_PERSON_TAG_EVIDENCE WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'RULE' AND EVIDENCE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND REVIEW_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PT_PERSON_TAG_EVIDENCE WHERE PERSON_ID = #{personId} AND TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND RULE_SET_ID = #{ruleSetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE PT_PERSON_TAG PT SET PT.STATUS = 'EXPIRED', PT.UPDATED_AT = #{updatedAt} WHERE PT.TAG_ID = #{tagId} AND PT.SOURCE_TYPE = 'RULE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PT_PERSON_TAG_EVIDENCE E WHERE E.PERSON_ID = PT.PERSON_ID AND E.TAG_ID = PT.TAG_ID AND E.EVIDENCE_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND E.REVIEW_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED') )
